newsitem.title: UK: TNT opens five new European depots.
newsitem.headline: TNT opens five new European depots.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide said it has opened five new European depots due to increasing business.
The new depots are situated in the Netherlands, Russia, Finland, Austria and Spain, the company added in a statement.

The key depot in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, is the first to be installed with the latest sorting technology. Equipped with 36 ramps, a new conveyor belt and a computer-controlled system to determine the weight and volume of goods, TNT said.

In Russia, TNT has opened a new high speed customs clearance warehouse on Leningradsky Prospect in Moscow where the new system has the capacity to handle an anticipated 400 percent increase in import flow of dutiable items into Russia. It sshould also cut customs clearance to 24 hours with a guaranteed minimum delivery time for international consignments, it added.

A 100 percent increase in demand over the last year has forced TNT to open a new depot in Tampere, Finland. In 1995 it handled more than 70,000 consignments, and the new depot is designed to cope with projected increases.
A new depot at Graz in Austria, has been opened following customer requests for greater capacity and better road connections. TNT Austria now handles 2,300 consignments a week.

The opening of a larger depot at the Prat de Llobregar airport in Catalonia makes it the largest TNT distribution centre in Cataluna handling more than 25,000 tonnes of goods each year,it added. TNT currently has eight distribution centres in Spain, with plans for a further two depots in Vitoria and Seville. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
